headline: Earnings decline year over year despite a sequential rebound
summary_short: True Data reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ¥1.34, down 23.0% y/y from ¥1.74.
summary_long: EPS of ¥1.34 fell 23.0% year-over-year from ¥1.74, though it rose 91.4% sequentially from ¥0.70 in the prior quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
